code_review: The four raw feature blocks have the frozen dimensions 52/60/104/112; EMA views append the fixed signed and absolute-innovation blocks at dimensions 224/224/336 and are built on complete sequences before stride selection.

The 32/64 component folds are deterministic partitions. Fold models use training components only; inner scoring uses held fit sequences and their full original masks. Eval array values are first consumed only by the outer score after alpha selection/refits.

Each case selects one shared two-target alpha by pooled canonical WP across held components; exact ties favor the larger alpha. The alpha1 baseline is retained. Outer component raw sums, official per-component metrics, drop-one pooled sensitivities, selected and baseline coefficients, normalizers and norms are recorded.
No R1 causal histories, masks or targets are changed; no learning-state or gradient claim is inferred from these linear probes.
